description: Sends an email with a one-time link to a free Quub API key. Not needed to search, hold or read a booking. A key raises the limits, lists its own bookings (list_bookings) and prices bookings at an 8 percent margin. The owner of the address opens the link, sees the key once and adds it to this connector (Authorization: Bearer quub_..., or ?key=quub_... on the server URL). Only send it to an address the person gave you for this.

label.description: A name for the key, e.g. the agent or app.

name: request_api_key
title: Request an API key
